key_insight: NextEval uses an LLM agent to coordinate numerical methods for derivative-free optimization, aiming to find better solutions with fewer costly objective evaluations.
engineering_relevance: The approach could reduce evaluation costs in simulation-based design and experiments where derivatives are unavailable or expensive.
method: An LLM agent selects numerical tools, configures parameters, and allocates the evaluation budget.
A numerical environment computes and evaluates candidate points while preserving shared history and method-specific state across switches.
NextEval Bench compares agent configurations using shared tasks, identical numerical tools, and matched evaluation budgets and information constraints.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports better function-evaluation efficiency than state-of-the-art DFO baselines on low-dimensional problems, without specifying effect sizes.
watch_item: Performance beyond low-dimensional problems and the added cost of LLM orchestration remain unclear from the abstract.
paper_title: NextEval: An Agent-Based Solver and Benchmark for Derivative-Free Optimization
